title: Tico runner wire contract
x-note: The core turn path between a runner and its server (docs/runner-wire-contract.md). Requests are the server's own models (requests.json, generated from backend/models.py); answers and errors are declared here from what the handlers send. An object with additionalProperties false is fully declared: the server sends nothing else. One with additionalProperties true is not contracted below that level yet: readers keep it as opaque JSON. x-open-enum marks a string whose readers must accept values not listed.

gated.x-note: Request fields, values and endpoints a runner sends only after the server says it takes them (or drops on a 422 that names them). The check allows them in the new-runner/old-server direction. Key: '<endpoint>.request<path>' as the check prints it; value: how the runner gates it.
gated.heartbeat.request.capabilities[]=\"priva: runner-rs lanes::refused_field drops it on the 422 that refuses it and sends it again ten minutes later
gated.heartbeat.request.capabilities[]=\"model: runner-rs/src/lanes.rs refused_field: an older server's 422 on capabilities drops the newest one for ten minutes
gated.heartbeat.request.capabilities[]=\"brows: runner-rs/src/lanes.rs refused_field: an older server's 422 on capabilities drops the newest one for ten minutes
gated.heartbeat.request.capabilities[]=\"model: runner-rs/src/lanes.rs refused_field: an older server's 422 on capabilities drops the newest one for ten minutes
gated.heartbeat.request.readiness.trust: runner-rs/src/readiness.rs trust_field: sent only once GET config says readiness_trust (fallback.rs server_takes_trust)
gated.complete.request.parent_message_id: echoed only from the claim's message.parent_message_id, which only a server with native threads sends; an older server's claim has none, so the runner never sends it there

Error.x-note: A refusal may carry one more fact beside these (store.Problem extra); readers ignore what they do not know.

start_places.x-note: The server takes start_places on claims (Claim.start_places).

browser_exit.x-note: This computer's owner shares its internet with bots: the runner holds its exit link open (backend/browser_exit.py).

browser_exit_bots.x-note: The bots on this computer with a browser exit set (backend/browser_exit.py bots_on): the runner stops every other bot's proxy. Absent from older servers: the runner then keeps its proxies.

paused.x-note: Why this computer gets no work (runner_versions.paused).

waiting.x-note: Why no turn starts here now (computer busy, company turn limit).

start_reservation_seconds.x-note: Sent when the claim asked with start_places.

token.x-note: The turn's own bearer token; a fixture holds a placeholder.

deferred.x-note: The prompt's block on what was deferred to this turn: its count line ("Deferred since your last turn: 2 comments, 1 task"), then the deferred comments and messages themselves, one a line, a bounded page; empty when nothing; an older server omits it.

browser_exit.x-note: The computer this bot's browser reaches the web through (backend/browser_exit.py for_turn), or null for none: the runner then drops the bot's proxy. Only to a runner with browser_exit_v1.

subscriptions.x-note: The company subscriptions this turn signs in with (its computer's, per runtime) (backend/model_subscriptions.py hand_out): ids and kinds, never values, which the run reads from credential-runtime. Only to a runner with model_subscriptions_v1; absent when none.

historical.x-note: The lease had lapsed: the output is archived, not applied.

job_state.x-note: A returned, never-started lease: the job's state after the hand-back.

filed.x-note: A late answer filed on its run rather than posted.

release.x-note: The release runners should run; empty on a development server.

kind.x-note: A runner re-reads everything for a kind it does not know (runner-rs/src/events.rs channels).
